- **2026-10-13** — D-205: tap the tab you are in to go back to its first page, and tap it again to jump to the top,
  as in most apps.

- **2026-10-13** — D-206: tap your picture to open You: your photo, name and username, with settings sorted into
  five groups instead of one long page. Balance now greets you by name.

- **2026-10-13** — D-207: adding someone to a group now lets you type their @username and see who it is before you
  add them, then add and invite them in one tap. People from your other groups are suggested, one tap each.

- **2026-10-13** — D-208: joining a group from an invitation in the app no longer says the invite was already used
  when it had in fact worked, and an invitation you have joined disappears from all your phones.

- **2026-10-13** — D-209: when you sign in, you pick a username, with suggestions from your name and a check that it
  is free as you type. You can change it once. Abusive and impersonating usernames are refused.

- **2026-10-14** — D-210: groups have an owner and admins. Anyone can ask to remove someone (or themselves); the owner
  or an admin decides. Someone who still owes or is owed is settled first, or their balance is shared out to people
  you pick, to the cent. The owner can delete a group, and everyone keeps a read-only copy. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-14** — D-211: your profile picture now syncs to all your phones, and your groups see a small preview of it
  next to your name. Once someone joins a group, the name shown for them is their own, not the one they were invited
  with. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-14** — D-212: pick a look under You, Appearance: Aurora (the new default, northern greens), Norse (black
  and gold, always dark) or Vardr Labs, each in light and dark, and make SKIPTI's text smaller or larger than your
  phone's. Night is gone for now; if you had it, SKIPTI is dark. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-15**: D-213: each theme now has its own look in the details. Norse draws runes on the tabs, a gold diamond
  for the +, notched cards, diamond tiles and a gold rune before section names; Vardr Labs draws a steel bolt for the +,
  square cards with corner marks, a faint dot grid and outlined buttons in mono capitals; every screen title takes the
  theme's own typeface. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-15**: D-214: the themes now move. Aurora's northern-light curtains sway over a starry night sky in dark mode
  and an arctic dawn in light mode; Norse's gold and silver runes rise slowly behind every screen; Vardr Labs' currency
  signs drift across the balance card, and the bolt on the + turns when you press it. Everything is gentle and stays
  readable, runs at 30 frames a second at most, and holds still when Reduce Motion or Low Power Mode is on. Not live until
  0.5.0.

- **2026-10-16**: D-215: both phones now draw the same type. SKIPTI bundles IBM Plex Sans for body text, buttons and labels in
  Aurora and Norse (Vardr Labs keeps Space Grotesk and Plex Mono), so iPhone no longer uses SF Pro and Android no longer uses
  Roboto for them; and our own rune font, Vardr Runes, draws every rune in Norse (the tab bar, the title ornament, the
  separators, the rising runes, the watermark) in the same shapes on both phones. Norse's tab runes are bigger, and every
  rectangular Norse button, field, panel and stat tile is notched like the cards. iPhone's alerts, menus and share sheet keep
  Apple's own type for now. The export proof screen, which had been failing since the schema 4 export, is fixed and now
  has a test. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-16**: D-217: both phones now use one type scale, iPhone's. Every size the D-215 look found different (the Balance
  date line and hero, the group card and People lines, the stat tiles, the Settle up text, the share inputs, the avatar
  initials) takes iOS's value on Android, and Android no longer fixes its line height. Android gets iPhone's way of titling:
  the four tab roots show a large 34 title that folds into the bar as a centred 17 title when you scroll, every other screen has
  the centred 17 title with a round back button, and sheets have Cancel and Done pills; the old per-screen headers are gone.
  Both phones draw the same chevron for back and for every list row. Names, kickers and section headings now follow the
  theme's roles (so names in Vardr Labs leave the mono face), the Norse ornament sits under the four large titles only, money
  shrinks to fit instead of being cut off, and Join is a sheet that cannot be left half-way once it starts. Onboarding is
  untouched. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-16**: D-218: the two D-210 leftovers. After a Settle all that pays past a middle person, People cards no longer
  show debts that only go round in a circle: core cancels every such loop by its smallest amount, the same way on both
  phones, and nobody's balance, the totals or the Settle all plan change. Inviting someone into a place a member has
  already joined is now refused by the cloud when the invite is made, with "Someone has already joined as this person."
  on both phones and no "Try again"; a removed person's place can still be invited again. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-16**: D-219: the tab bar and the + now look as the Look Book draws them in each theme, the same on both
  phones. Every icon is drawn a little bolder (stroke 2.4), the + bolder still. In Aurora the chosen tab is a filled
  accent pill and the + casts a soft neutral shadow; Norse and Vardr Labs get a solid bar; every theme has a thin rule
  along the bar's top; Norse's diamond + is as large as the circle, and Vardr Labs' hexagon carries the Look Book's
  reticle. Every bar now has one height whatever the theme, so Norse's last row no longer sits under it, and a tap on any
  tip of the + opens Add. Android's back arrow is now the same size as iPhone's. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-16**: D-220: the small shared pieces now take each theme's shape, the same on both phones. Chips and
  labels are round in Aurora, notched in Norse and square and outlined in Vardr Labs; nothing round sits inside a Vardr
  Labs card any more; group photos, the spending bar and Norse's diamond tiles follow the theme; Vardr Labs' hero "Settle
  up" is outlined; the violet group colour is now blue. Norse and Vardr Labs get solid top bars on both phones, and on
  Android the Aurora bars blur what scrolls under them as iPhone's do. On Android, disabled buttons dim as on iPhone, the
  currency list opens as a page, the back and account buttons sit where iPhone puts them, and recently added people dim.
  "People in" links are easier to tap. Vardr Labs light's accent text is a little darker so it reads over the dot grid.
  Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-16**: D-221: the four small rewards, the same on both phones. Your picture on You now sits in a ring that
  fills as you set SKIPTI up (in Norse, 24 runes light in gold), with "n of 5 done" in its place and a card for the next
  step and a "Do it" button; nothing in it asks you to make an account. A group's page opens with a plain header and a
  Settled card: how much of what was owed has been marked paid, a bar per currency, and what is still to settle. Under it
  sits the next payment with a "Settle" button that records it, the same one Settle up shows. When the last debt is
  settled the page shows a short celebration that never blocks a tap, still when you ask for less motion. A group
  marks 100 expenses together and a year together for two weeks. Initials avatars take the theme's colours. On Android,
  dates now read the way your language writes them, as on iPhone. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-17**: D-222: You's list and Appearance, the same on both phones. Each row on You has an icon in the theme's
  tile and a live line under its title: your sign-in and how many phones use your account, your theme and light or dark,
  when the app locks, and the version. Appearance shows the three themes as small previews of their own dark art,
  a drawn light or dark control (in Norse it shows Dark, since Norse is always dark), and a drawn text-size slider with a
  sample line, "Dinner at Thalassa", in your own default currency, that grows as you slide. Screen readers still get
  the phone's own controls, and on Android the slider also moves with arrow keys and takes your first tap. Not live
  until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-17**: D-223: Home, "Your ledgers" and "Lately", the same on both phones. Under today's balance a line now
  says who owes whom ("Meera owes you ₹3,050.00 ᛫ Sam owes you ₹3,000.00"). Your groups sit below it as cards in two
  columns, each with how much is owed and a bar for how much is settled. A "Lately" card shows the three newest changes
  others made, each opening its expense, with "See all" for the whole ledger's activity. People come after. Times read
  the same on both phones ("2 min", "3 h", then the date). An empty Expenses list shows one drawn picture and the same words
  on both. On Android, Home keeps its place when you come back, and an expense opened from Activity goes back to
  Activity. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-17**: D-224: done moments and haptics, the same on both phones. When you finish something, the app now says
  so: a small bar rises above the tab bar for three seconds ("Expense added · Dinner · ₹1,200.00", "Name saved",
  "Settled with Sam · ₹3,000.00"), and once-only moments get a check that draws itself (in Norse, inside the turning rune
  ring): your first group, signing in, joining a group, and erasing this phone's ledger. Add expense now closes at once
  instead of pausing on "Saved". Nothing waits for these and nothing under them stops working. The phone gives a light
  tap when you switch tabs, a success tap when something is done, and a warning tap when the app asks before something that
  cannot be undone; a new Haptics row on Appearance, under Text size, turns them off. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-17**: D-225: the settings screens and the forms, the same on both phones. Security, Your data, About,
  Licences, Group settings, People, Profile, Add and Edit expense, New group and Your name are now drawn from the same
  rows and cards on iPhone and Android, with the same drawn switch and the same fields. App lock opens a page of
  choices; every choice a form makes (category, split type, who paid, the group) opens a page with a check instead of a
  menu; the currency always opens the full currency list. Erasing this phone's ledger now opens a page that explains it
  before the button, and still asks first. The lock screen shows a lock on both phones. Both phones show the same four
  hints under the split types, and the "Added by" line on an expense reads the same, in your phone's 12 or 24-hour time.
  If the ledger will not open, both phones now offer "Try again" first; erasing stays the last resort, still asks, and
  signs you out first as the other erase does. "Your phones" now says so when the list cannot load, with Try again.
  On Android, Expenses, Groups and Settle up keep your place when you come back. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-18**: D-226: the theme art, the same on both phones. Norse's notches, Vardr Labs' corner marks, the grid
  and the title ornament are now drawn a quarter larger, in step with the text they sit beside. In Aurora's dark night
  the stars shine over the northern lights instead of behind them. Norse's page has a faint gold glow at the top and a
  silver one at the bottom, its hero card a warm diagonal, and its cards an edge along the straight sides only, with the
  cut corners left clean. Aurora's frosted cards now look the same on iPhone and Android: the same blur of the art
  behind them, the same edge and the same soft shadow. On Android, the top bar in Aurora dark takes the iPhone's colour,
  and its title stays readable whatever scrolls under it. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-18**: D-216: SKIPTI's new icon, the cut S, on both phones, in three versions: Aurora's (the one everyone
  starts with), Norse's gold and silver, and Vardr Labs' steel on light. Appearance has a new App icon section: with
  "Match theme" on, as it is from the start, the icon follows your theme; or pick any of the three yourself. The icon
  changes when you leave the Appearance page, so the iPhone's own "You have changed the icon" message appears once,
  after you have chosen, never while you are still trying themes. On Android, notifications now show the cut S in the
  status bar instead of a bell. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-18**: D-227: two group fixes. On iPhone, a group you make from Balance, and a name you add there, now show
  at once on Groups, Expenses and Settle up. And if you use one account on two phones, each group now knows you by the
  place it was made or joined with: the group's owner sees the Owner label and the owner's choices on either phone,
  everyone else sees it too, and your name and picture reach every group. If the cloud cannot answer for a moment, the
  phone tries again by itself, both to learn who is who and to share your name. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-18**: D-228: no more long dashes in what SKIPTI shows you. Where an amount cannot be shown, both phones now
  show a short hyphen, and screen readers say "none" there; a settle-up reads "Settled with Ana.
  Recorded in your ledger. No money moved."; a duplicate row in an import reads "Duplicate: ..."; and the reasons an
  import row is refused read with colons. The README and the other public pages lost theirs too, and a check now stops a
  long dash from coming back. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-18**: D-229: if you use one account on two phones, what you add to a group now shows as you on the other
  members' phones instead of "Unknown member", so everyone's balances agree. Expenses and payments already added the
  old way become readable for everyone once your updated phone next syncs; nothing you wrote is changed. If someone
  else in a group ever holds your place there, that group pauses on your phone with a plain note, rather than writing
  your money under the wrong name, and it no longer offers to remove the group from your phone. Tapping an invite to a
  group you are already in now says "You're already in this group." Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-19**: D-230: your place in a group is now confirmed by SKIPTI's cloud, so nobody else in the group can claim
  it or the expenses you added there, whatever their phone sends. Joining by a link confirms your place as you join;
  places you already hold are confirmed the next time your updated phone syncs, and a place you held before leaving and
  rejoining keeps its history. A link to a place someone was removed from no longer works. On your own phone, the line
  saying a removed place's balance moved now names you instead of "Unknown member", and no longer leaves out a person
  it moved to. Nothing you wrote is changed. Not
  live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-19**: D-231: a new switch on Appearance, after Haptics: **Less motion**, "Still art, fewer animations".
  With it on, the theme art holds a still picture, the done moments and the settle celebration play without movement,
  and the tab bar and the bars stop springing and sliding, on both phones. Your phone's own Reduce Motion still does the
  same whatever the switch says. On a phone with little memory it starts on until you change it. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-19**: D-232: a new install now opens in Aurora dark on both phones, whatever the phone's own light or dark
  setting. Light and System are still on Appearance, and a choice you make always wins. If SKIPTI was already on your
  phone before this change and you never chose, nothing changes: it keeps following your phone. The launch screen,
  shown before the app has started, still follows the phone, so a new install on a light phone shows light for a
  moment before it turns dark; on Android 12 and later it follows your choice from the next launch, and so does the
  text-selection bar. On Android, the app lock no longer asks again when you rotate the phone or switch between light
  and dark; leaving the app still locks it as before. Not live until 0.5.0.


2026-10-19 (D-233): The decision 31 blur bake was built and measured on Android and not shipped: it made no measurable difference to scrolling on the test device and used more memory. Aurora's scroll is checked on a real phone before 0.5.0; the change is kept ready if that phone needs it.

- **2026-10-19**: D-234: the two phones now match in a dozen places the looks found. On Appearance, the text-size
  sample always reads "Lunch at Shake Shack, $48.00", and App icon is one row showing your choice that opens to the four
  options when you tap it. Haptics now reads "A tap when it is done" and You's account row "Google · 2 phones", so
  nothing is cut off on a small phone. On iPhone, the tab bar no longer goes missing after you join a group, and a
  group you were removed from no longer looks faded. If none of your groups can take a new record from this phone, Add
  expense and Settle up now say so. An expense added by someone later removed from the group still shows their name.
  The words that celebrate a settled group sit on a card, expense rows are laid out the same on both phones, a
  greyed-out button looks the same too, and on Android nine cards now have the iPhone's inner spacing. On an Android phone, the app stays upright like the iPhone, Add expense's title no longer
  rests half hidden under the bar, and Balance no longer flashes a greeting before it loads. Not live until 0.5.0.

- **2026-10-19**: D-235: a full check of SKIPTI before the public beta, and its fixes. When someone changes the amount
  or the split of a shared expense, everyone in the group now sees it; it did not reach the other phones before, and
  after you update, the changes that went missing arrive. SKIPTI checks the money in every shared expense, so one
  wrong record from someone else can no longer break your balances or your export. On iPhone the app lock now covers
  everything, an open sheet included, the app switcher shows a plain cover, and an invite link waits until you unlock.
  Reinstalling SKIPTI on an iPhone now starts signed out: sign in again to sync (if an earlier build signed you back
  in by itself, it signs you out once). Without an account SKIPTI makes no network request at all, now measured: on
  Android it no longer fetches an emoji font, on iPhone it no longer looks up a Google address. On Android a quick
  double tap on Add expense saves once, and a picture from a group member can no longer crash the app. Signing out
  while offline is quick, and that account's notifications stop: on iPhone at once, on Android once it is back
  online. If a change cannot sync (a phone clock far off, say), the rest keeps syncing and its group shows a quiet
  line: "One change could not sync. It is still on this phone." A note can be up to 1,000 characters. An open expense updates when someone else edits it.
  Invitations name the person and the group as SKIPTI's cloud knows them, a removed member can no longer come back
  with an old invite link, and anyone can always be removed from a group. Not live until 0.5.0.

2026-10-19 (D-236): SKIPTI is now version 0.5.0 (iOS build 7, Android 5000), with a release runbook and a plan for 0.5.1. The privacy page now says a small copy of your profile picture is shared with your groups. The key that unlocks your ledger is now wiped from memory as soon as it is no longer needed. Nothing is released yet.

2026-10-19 (D-237): the pre-release security check for 0.5.0, and three fixes. A place you joined as in one group no longer counts as you in any other group, so someone who makes a group with a copied id can no longer make another person's expenses show up as yours on your phone. Each change you record now takes a random step in its id, so nobody can pre-empt your edits by guessing them. And whoever registered an id first keeps it: a copied profile can no longer strip you of the server's record of your place in a group, or make you impossible to invite. Nothing is released yet.

2026-10-19 (D-238): the Android release build now passes its dependency check: the lint tool a release build runs had never had its checksums recorded. Nothing in the app changed.

2026-10-20 (D-239): animations play again when the phone is saving power. On some iPhones (an iPhone 17 with Adaptive Power) SKIPTI showed no animation at all; now only the background art pauses to save power, and every small moment, a check, a toast, a switch, the settle celebration, plays unless Reduce Motion or Less motion is on. Ships in 0.5.1.

2026-10-20 (D-240): deleting a group now says "Group deleted" and takes you straight back, on both phones. On iPhone a group deleted on that phone used to leave an empty Group settings screen behind; that is fixed. Ships in 0.5.1.

2026-10-20 (D-241): until you choose a default currency, SKIPTI no longer ticks one for you. The list shows your phone's currency first as a suggestion; tap any currency to choose it. Ships in 0.5.1.

2026-10-20 (D-242): the Norse theme is more vibrant on both phones: a warmer, richer gold, a deeper ground, jade for what you are owed and copper for what you owe, and clearer card edges. Aurora and Vardr Labs are unchanged, and so is the Norse app icon. Ships in 0.5.1.

2026-10-20 (D-243): the Norse theme comes alive on both phones: the rising runes glow and flare now and then, each in its own lane; the Balance card gets its own rising runes and its rune glows; the ring of runes round your picture on You turns slowly; and Norse cards carry a thin gold glow. Everything holds still with Reduce Motion or Less motion, and the art pauses when the phone saves power. On iPhone the sign-in card now shows the Norse edges as Android does. Ships in 0.5.1.

2026-10-20 (D-244): with an account, your look and your default currency follow you to your other phones: the theme, light or dark, text size, Less motion, haptics, the app icon and the default currency. A phone that signs in takes your account's settings. Without an account nothing leaves the phone, and with sync off changes stay where they are. The app lock and its timeout stay on each phone. The privacy page says so. Ships in 0.5.1, after the privacy page is published.

2026-10-21 (D-245): a new install now opens with a short welcome: what is where, a theme to pick (it changes as you tap), your name and your picture, each saved only when you say so, then a choice to start a group or look around. Every step can be skipped and none mentions an account. In Norse the progress is a winding road between five runes that light as you go. On You, choosing a picture now asks before it is saved and shared. About can show the welcome again. Guarantee 5 now says plainly that sharing a group with other people's phones needs an account.

2026-10-21 (D-246): in Norse, glowing runes now glow from their own shape instead of a round halo: the rising runes on every page, the runes on the Balance hero, the big ᚠ and the ring round your picture on You. The text over them stays as readable as before.

2026-10-21 (D-247): Settle up can record part of a debt ("Another amount"), and every settle waits a few seconds behind an Undo before it is written. When you owe nothing in a group but others still do, it says you are settled rather than that the group is. The payment count matches the plan Settle up shows. On a phone with no passcode the You ring no longer waits for an app lock it cannot set.

2026-10-21 (D-248): amounts can be typed with a decimal comma where the phone uses one; New group adds the next person when you press Return; a new expense opens with the amount ready to type; deleting an expense offers Undo right there; making a group opens it; screen titles and bar buttons stay whole and look the same on both phones at every text size. Several small messages now say what to do instead of naming the wrong tab.

2026-10-21 (D-249): Just me: keep what you spend on your own, next to your groups. Add an expense to Just me from the +, and see this month's spending on Home under your ledgers, by category, or switch to All my spending to add your share of every group. It never changes who owes whom. Spending on Home can be switched off under Appearance. The export gains a category column, and a Wallet file can go into Just me.

2026-10-21 (D-250): things move instead of jumping: amounts roll when they change, rows slide in and out, meters and the You ring fill, pills slide, the theme changes with a crossfade, and Android's pages now push and return the way iPhone's do. Reduce Motion and Less motion turn it all into plain cuts.

2026-10-21 (D-251): for the store screenshots, debug builds can fill the app with a sample ledger (Sam, Meera, Kiran, Rahul and Ana; a trip, a flat, a weekend in Paris, and this month's own spending) so every store image shows real screens. It cannot run in a store build and never deletes a ledger it did not make.

2026-10-21 (D-252): a group deleted on one of your phones now ends on your other phones too, and on every member's: it stays as a read-only copy with its history, says who deleted it, and refuses anything new instead of keeping a change that can never sync. A phone that missed the news catches up the next time it opens. Ships with 0.5.1, together with the server change.

2026-10-21 (D-253): split rows keep each person's name beside their amount while you type, and Appearance's text-size sample reads "Lunch with Luna".

2026-10-22 (D-254): new accounts wait for approval before anything is kept in the cloud. Anyone can sign in, and the ledger on the phone works fully meanwhile; the phone says so plainly and starts syncing the moment the account is approved. The founder approves on a small private page. Profile and account now puts your sign-in, Sign out and your username first. Ships with 0.5.1; nothing is deployed yet.

2026-10-22 (D-255): the store pictures, the film clips and the README now show a New York ledger in US dollars, at the full detail the phones draw, and a long group name on Home wraps to a second line instead of being cut off.

2026-10-22 (D-256): a deleted group stays deleted. Deleting a group now leaves a small marker in the cloud, so another phone that still held the group can never bring it back; that phone shows the group as deleted and keeps what was on it. Ships with 0.5.1; nothing is deployed yet.

2026-10-22 (D-257): the cloud now limits each group's invites, joins and removals per day, and how many notifications one person's changes can send in a day; and a notification's words are now put together by the cloud from the expense's checked details and the sender's own profile name, rather than taken from the sender's phone. Nothing you see in the app changes. Ships with 0.5.1; nothing is deployed yet.

2026-10-22 (D-258): when you sign a phone out from another phone, the cloud now refuses anything new that phone tries to save, and the phone signs itself out the moment it is refused, instead of waiting to notice on its own. Sign out everywhere remains the complete answer for a lost phone. Ships with 0.5.1; nothing is deployed yet.

2026-10-22 (D-259): one group with impossibly large amounts can no longer blank your whole Home. That group's card now says "Amounts too large to add up." and every other group, your totals and your people show as usual. The app also refuses to take the app lock and privacy settings from a group's records: those stay on each phone. Ships with 0.5.1.

2026-10-22 (D-260): the test-only screens are now left out of the builds people install, on both phones, rather than only switched off; a new gate check fails if one ever comes back. Nothing you see changes. Ships with 0.5.1.

2026-10-24 (D-261): the cloud's request reader is updated past a newly published flaw that could knock the cloud's functions over with one bad request (no data could be read). The functions now carry their own locked copy of Google's serving layer, so the dependency check sees what really runs. Ships with 0.5.1's cloud deploy.

2026-10-24 (D-262): the iPhone app takes Firebase's update that stops trusting a certificate authority whose keys leaked last week, so nobody holding those keys can listen in on the app's cloud sync. Nothing you see changes. Ships with 0.5.1.
